title: Multi-target activity of copper complexes: Antibacterial, DNA binding, and molecular docking with SARS-CoV-2 receptor.
authors: Arthi, Padmanathan; Dharmasivam, Mahendiran; Kaya, Busra; Rahiman, Aziz Kalilur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜配合物的抗菌活性、与DNA的沟槽结合及与SARS-CoV-2受体的分子对接，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法仅为常规对接，与TF-DNA结合机制建模关联较弱。
abstract: A series of pendant-armed mixed-ligand copper(II) complexes of the type [CuL(1-3)(diimine)] (1-6) have been synthesized by the reaction of pendant-armed ligands N,N-bis(2-(((E)-2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzylidene)amino)ethyl)benzamide (H(2)L(1)), N,N-bis(2-(((E)-2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzylidene)amino)ethyl)-4-nitrobenzamide (H(2)L(2)) and N,N-bis(2-(((E)-2-hydroxy-5-methylbenzylidene)amino)ethyl)-3,5-dinitrobenzamide (H(2)L(3)) with diimine = 2,2'-bipyridyl (bpy) or 1,10-phenanthroline (phen) in the presence of copper(II) chloride and analyzed using various spectroscopic methods. All the spectroscopic results support that the complexes adopt a pentagonal-bipyramidal shape around the copper ion. Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria were used to test all the complexes for antibacterial activity and all the complexes had greater potency against gram-negative pathogens. DNA-binding experiments of complexes with calf thymus DNA revealed a major-groove binding pattern, further supported by molecular docking studies. Complexes have significantly interacted with SARS-CoV-2 receptor via pi-pi, pi-sigma, pi-alkyl, pi-anion, pi-cation, alkyl, hydrogen bond, van der Waals, and electrostatic interactions. The estimated binding energy and inhibition constant of these complexes are higher than standard drugs, chloroquine, and molnupiravir.
abstract_zh: 合成了一系列带有悬臂的混合配体铜(II)配合物，类型为[CuL(1-3)(diimine)] (1-6)，通过悬臂配体N,N-双(2-(((E)-2-羟基-5-甲基苄叉)氨基)乙基)苯甲酰胺 (H(2)L(1))、N,N-双(2-(((E)-2-羟基-5-甲基苄叉)氨基)乙基)-4-硝基苯甲酰胺 (H(2)L(2)) 和 N,N-双(2-(((E)-2-羟基-5-甲基苄叉)氨基)乙基)-3,5-二硝基苯甲酰胺 (H(2)L(3)) 与二亚胺 = 2,2'-联吡啶 (bpy) 或 1,10-菲咯啉 (phen) 在氯化铜存在下反应制得，并使用多种光谱方法进行了分析。所有光谱结果均支持这些配合物在铜离子周围采用五角双锥几何构型。使用革兰氏阳性菌和革兰氏阴性菌对所有配合物进行了抗菌活性测试，所有配合物对革兰氏阴性病原体具有更强的效力。配合物与小牛胸腺DNA的DNA结合实验揭示了大沟结合模式，分子对接研究进一步支持了这一结果。配合物通过π-π、π-σ、π-烷基、π-阴离子、π-阳离子、烷基、氢键、范德华力和静电相互作用与SARS-CoV-2受体显著相互作用。这些配合物的估计结合能和抑制常数高于标准药物氯喹和莫诺匹拉韦。
